hero.title: About RRMS
hero.subtitle: Find rooms, apartments, manage rental operations, and connect housing demand on one modern and transparent platform.
hero.description: An information channel that helps tenants find rooms more easily and helps landlords reach the right renters faster.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Finding a room has never been easy for students and people working away from home. From real-life experience, the RRMS team understands how it feels to visit many places, face unclear information, and spend too much time before finding a suitable place to stay.

RRMS was built to solve that problem with technology, helping tenants find rooms faster and more clearly while helping landlords reach the right renters more efficiently. Our goal is to create a modern, practical, and trustworthy rental ecosystem.
story.cardDescription: Optimize the rental journey and improve landlord reach.

missionVision.title: Our mission and vision
missionItems: Provide smart solutions that help tenants and landlords connect faster, more clearly, and with more confidence throughout the rental journey.
Create a transparent rental environment that saves time, reduces costs, and raises the overall service experience.
missionVision.visionText: RRMS aims to become a leading technology platform in room search, apartment search, and rental operations management, where transparent data and user experience are always central.
missionVision.quoteBody: RRMS product thinking is about creating a better, clearer, and more scalable living and rental experience.

coreValues.title: Core values
items: Innovative thinking to solve real problems
Deliver real value to both tenants and landlords
Complete the full journey from experience to operational efficiency
Always stay transparent, clear, and honest at every touchpoint
Continuously listen and improve the product based on market needs
Apply practical technology to save time and costs

capability.title: Team and capability
items: 10+ years of experience in software, website, and app development
Hands-on delivery experience across proptech, ecommerce, and logistics problems
A disciplined workflow with clear ownership and strong scalability
A young, dedicated, practical team focused on real customer value
